_about: Track E (building parts kit) hand-off between the parts thread and the materials thread (shore plan, Nov 16 2026). The parts kit (Tools/envloop/buildkit) writes meshes with these slots, UV rules and paint roles; the materials thread fills the Wall, Roof and Glass looks and the wear. Changing a name here changes both halves: say so in both threads.
units: metres; Z up; a part's origin on the wall plane it mounts to, +Y out of the wall (toward the street or yard), +X along the wall to the right when facing the house

Trim.uv0: trim sheet (trim.json bands), true scale 4 px/cm
Trim.notes: every painted, metal, wood, vinyl and concrete part; colour from the paint role (vertex colour R) unless the band is unpainted

Glass.uv0: pane-local 0..1 (u right, v up, seen from outside)
Glass.uv1: pane size in metres (u width, v height), constant over the pane
Glass.notes: fake interior (room atlas 4x4, depth one window width by default), reflections, lit at dusk; vertex colour G = window seed 0..1 (same for every pane of one window), B = 1 for obscure (bathroom) glass, A = 1 when the pane is a door light. Muntins and grilles are Trim geometry in front of the glass.

Wall.uv0: world metres along the wall (u) and up from the ground line (v), so courses line up across parts and the house wall
Wall.notes: chimney bodies, dormer cheeks, porch knee walls, gable fill; finish code in vertex colour G (wall_finishes index / 255)

Roof.uv0: metres along the eave (u) and up the slope from the eave (v)
Roof.notes: dormer and porch roofs; finish code in vertex colour G (roof_finishes index / 255)

vertex_colour.R: paint role index / 255 (paint_roles); Trim slot only
vertex_colour.G: Wall/Roof: finish index / 255. Glass: room seed

paint_roles.name: trim
paint_roles.what: casings, fascia, frieze, corner boards, porch columns and rails, soffit

paint_roles.name: sash
paint_roles.what: window frames and sashes (white vinyl, almond, bronze or black)

paint_roles.name: garage
paint_roles.what: garage door panels (usually the trim colour or white)

paint_roles.name: metal
paint_roles.what: gutters and downspouts (white, brown or galvanised), flashing

paint_roles.name: fixed
paint_roles.what: own colour from the trim sheet's colour map: concrete, iron, brass, galvanised, rubber, cedar

per_house_paint: the game passes one colour per paint role 0..5 per house (instance custom data, 6 x RGB); the style recipes in styles/*.json give the palettes

wall_finishes.name: brick_red
wall_finishes.module: king size 244 x 70 mm faces, 10 mm joints, 76 mm course (materials thread)

wall_finishes.name: brick_buff
wall_finishes.module: Texas buff / tan blend, same module

wall_finishes.name: board_batten
wall_finishes.module: vertical boards, 64 mm battens at 305 mm centres

trim_sheet: trim.json (written by make_trim_sheet.py): bands and cells with their pixel and UV rectangles
painted_trim_colours: styles/*.json palettes: role colours as sRGB hex; the materials thread may reuse them for painted siding
